objective: expand ProductProof coverage (cli_invocation, file_artifact, process_effect, richer python_callable observables) while preserving every Cycle-1 assurance property; no frozen item changes; no architecture exception is required (see CYCLE2-F5-COMPATIBILITY-REPORT.md)

owner_decisions_required_before_implemen.DECISION-5: whether a PlanQualityPolicy is preregistered for the Cycle-2 LedgerLock regression rerun (absent -> NOT_CLAIMED again)

prove the reference passes and each mutant fails an independent acceptance

stop_rules: any frozen item F1-F11 would change: STOP, draft an Architecture Exception, do not implement around it
a new probe kind needs a verdict no observation class can assign under §9.2: STOP
a Cycle-1 identity of architecture_baseline drifts: STOP
a probe verdict is shown to depend on anything outside (revision SHA, ProductProofSpec, capability identity): STOP (P7-FINDING-001 class)
LedgerLock is asked to become HOLDOUT/SEALED or to back a generalization statement: refuse (mechanical)
a control-plane, journal, projection, admission or orchestration change is needed for a probe: STOP, separate owner decision

scheduling_rules.phase_barriers: strict: a package is runnable only when its declared dependencies are complete AND its phase's barrier phase is evidence-complete
scheduling_rules.parallelism: C2-P1, C2-P2 and C2-P4 may run in parallel after C2-P0 (disjoint probe modules, disjoint fixtures, disjoint evidence); C2-P3 follows C2-P2 (shares the protocol channel); C2-P10 may run in parallel with C2-P7..C2-P9 (disjoint scope) once C2-P6 is complete
scheduling_rules.validator: deferred: validation/v2/plan_validate.py encodes Cycle-1 checks (WP-0.4 guard ancestry, WP-6.2 orchestration); a Cycle-2 validator generalising checks A, B, E, G is WP-2.0.1's first task
scheduling_rules.attempt_history: closure-evidence/v2/cycle2/<phase>-RUN-HISTORY.json under the same retry policy; the completed attempts of 503b3a2 (local suite 4762 OK; CI 36383314097 7/7) open the first Cycle-2 history
